***Core Design Philosophy***

This project sits somewhere between vanilla JS, early jQuery-era UI libraries, and modern frameworks like React/Vue, but with much lower overhead. It is simply a library full of vanilla HTML/CSS/JS elements that look and work great out of the box, and can look even better with custom css applied.

For this project the following goals should be followed:

* Zero build step (just ``<script src="...">``)
* Low cognitive overhead
* HTML is generated by JS
* Opinionated but simple default CSS
* Progressive enhancement
* No virtual DOM
* Minimal magic

Think:
``“If someone knows HTML + basic JS, they can use this in 10 minutes.”``

---

***High-Level Architecture***

The framework consists of 3 layers:

```js
[ User JS ]
    ↓
[ Component System ]
    ↓
[ DOM Generator ]
    ↓
[ HTML + CSS + Behavior ]
```

Files:
```
myframework/
├─ Elemental.js     # core JS
├─ Elemental.css    # default styles
└─ addons/
   ├─ menu.js
   ├─ modal.js
   └─ tabs.js
```

usage:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="Elemental.css">
<script src="Elemental.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
```

---

***API Design***

```js
MF.el("button", {
  class: "mf-button",
  onClick: () => alert("Hi")
}, "Click me");
```

---

***CSS Strategy***

**Goals:**
* Reasonable defaults
* Easily overridable
* No inline styles
* No CSS-in-JS

**Strategy:**
* Single CSS file
* Use class-based styling
* Use CSS variables

---

***How This Differs From React/Vue***

| Feature | React | Your Framework |
|---------|-------|----------------|
| Build step | Required | None |
| Size | Large | Tiny |
| Virtual DOM | Yes | No |
| Learning curve | Steep | Gentle |
| Debugging | Abstract | DOM-native |

This framework is:
``“A structured way to write vanilla JS UI.”``
